name: Scavenger
source:
Leroux is a supersized dystopian city where all your wildest dreams and nightmares can be made real. That being said: this story, unlike my other games, is a bit darker. Scavenger tells the tale of what happens to individuals who find themselves too deeply entrenched in the muck and mire that Leroux offers. It is sexual, it is violent, it is aggressive and grimy.

Scavenger is a story about excess and fulfillment, set in a bleak future where sex and violence run rampant.

[From [url=https://droptineart.itch.io/scavenger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
勒鲁是一座超大的反乌托邦城市，在这里你所有最疯狂的梦想和噩梦都可以成为现实。话虽这么说：这个故事与我的其他游戏不同，有点黑暗。《清道夫》讲述了那些发现自己深深陷入勒鲁提供的淤泥和泥沼中的人所发生的故事。它是性的、暴力的、攻击性的和肮脏的。

《清道夫》是一个关于过度和满足的故事，背景设定在性和暴力猖獗的暗淡未来。

[来自[url=https://droptineart.itch.io/scavenger]Itch.io[/url]]
